name: ai-rpu

mods.name: Fallout 2 Restoration Project, updated (RPU)
mods.install_doc: https://github.com/BGforgeNet/Fallout2_Restoration_Project/blob/master/docs/linux.md (extract zip into game dir, run rpu-install.sh)

mods.name: FO2Tweaks
mods.install_doc: https://github.com/BGforgeNet/FO2tweaks (copy mods/ into game dir; fo2tweaks.dat is already in RPU's mods_order.txt)

notes: RPU v2.4.34 + FO2Tweaks v14.7. NPC Armor, Party Orders and the Cassidy head are already bundled in RPU and not added again.
FO2Tweaks' ddraw.dll (sfall) is skipped: CE doesn't use it, and it would overwrite RPU's.

Inventory Filter is NOT included: it needs sfall AllowUnsafeScripting (direct memory access), which CE cannot provide; the mobile fork reimplements its filters natively. Tested separately, see docs/MOD-MATRIX.md.
Talking Heads (Lexx) is NOT included: no official repository/release page found to download from.
fallout2.cfg next to this manifest is the profile's whole config (RPU's, with the CE, touch and AI settings); overlay/ is copied over the mods last.
